one_line: OpenAI and Apple escalated their dispute with a countersuit, while enterprise AI adoption, new robotics funding, and grid adaptations made headlines.

themes.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
themes.text: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court, accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers in an ongoing dispute over employees and hardware.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats

themes.title: Embo raises $110 million for robotics
themes.text: Embo emerged from stealth with $110 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz to develop robot world models trained on internet video, humanoids, and reinforcement learning.

stories.headline: Embo emerges from stealth with $110M seed led by a16z for robot world models

themes.title: EU workplace AI use matches US
themes.text: A European Central Bank survey found that weekly workplace AI use in the EU matched US levels at 44%, while daily use reached 18%, surpassing the US.

stories.headline: European Central Bank survey shows EU workplace AI use matches US levels

themes.title: Palantir signs $300 million Poland deal
themes.text: Palantir secured a five-year, $300 million contract with Poland to provide the Saturn AI system for aggregating military data from drones, satellites, and radar.

stories.headline: Palantir signs $300 million deal with Poland for military AI
